environment.description: EKS pod in isolated subnet with com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 Gateway VPC Endpoint. The endpoint policy uses a condition-based restriction: aws:ResourceAccount must equal the owning account AND s3:prefix must begin with 'processed/' via StringLike condition. The pod's IRSA role has s3:PutObject scoped to arn:aws:s3:::prod-events-sink/processed/* but the VPC endpoint policy additionally enforces that ANY S3 API call transiting the endpoint must target bucket 'prod-events-sink' specifically (Resource: arn:aws:s3:::prod-events-sink/*) with a StringEquals condition on s3:x-amz-acl set to bucket-owner-full-control. Kafka topic has schema registry enforcement with Avro schema validation requiring 'metadata' field to be a flat map of string->string (no nested objects allowed).

config.kafka_schema_registry: Confluent Schema Registry with FULL_TRANSITIVE compatibility, Avro schema enforces metadata as map<string,string>
config.network: Isolated subnet, no NAT, no internet gateway, S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint only
